questions.question: Who among the following was given the charge of looking after the imperial household during the Mughal administration?
questions.solution:
• Mir Saman: Mir Saman
  • Mughal Admin: The officer in charge of the royal household and Karkhanas.

questions.question: Who among the following was the disciple of Ramakrishna Paramahansa?
questions.solution:
• Vivekananda's Guru: Swami Vivekananda
  • Note: He carried the message of Ramakrishna to the World Parliament of Religions in 1893.

questions.question: Which National Waterway runs from Haldia to Prayagraj?
questions.solution:
• NW1: National Waterway 1
  • Route: Spans across the Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly river system.

questions.question: Who among the following devoted his life for the upliftment of widows and established the Widow Remarriage Association in 1893?
questions.solution:
• D.K. Karve: D.K. Karve
  • Fact: A Bharat Ratna awardee who pioneered women's education in India.
